title: Discord’s Powerful Cross-Platform Chat: Ready for Your Game
summary: The Discord Social SDK is coming out of closed beta! Developers can now take advantage of Discord’s voice and text chat in their games and help players connect for longer playtimes by enhancing their multiplayer experiences.
body:
We’re thrilled to announce that the Discord Social SDK communication features are coming out of closed beta! Now, developers can take full advantage of Discord voice and text chat, connecting players for longer playtimes, and enhancing multiplayer experiences. 

‍Launched during GDC this year, the Discord Social SDK enables you to integrate Discord-powered social features directly in your game to maximize player connections and extend play times through more meaningful multiplayer interactions. Even without a Discord account, players can easily connect with friends, make new ones, and jump into your game.
